title: The Last Delivery
synopsis: On the night a small town loses power, a young delivery rider must get life-saving medicine across flooded streets before dawn, while an old mechanic and a frightened child help him find another way.
credit: An original story created for Cinema Radio.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Rain had swallowed the streets by nightfall. Sam was preparing to finish his last delivery when his phone rang again.

scenes.speaker: mama
scenes.text: Sam, please. Daniel needs the medicine tonight. The clinic closes before morning.

scenes.speaker: sam
scenes.text: I am coming. Keep him warm and stay by the phone.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Sam grabbed the small medicine box from his delivery bag and stepped back into the rain.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The main road was already underwater. A fallen sign blocked the bridge, and every route on Sam's phone ended in red lines.

scenes.speaker: sam
scenes.text: There has to be another way.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Sam reached a tiny repair shop where one light was still burning. Inside, Emeka was closing for the night.

scenes.speaker: sam
scenes.text: Uncle Emeka, do you know a road that is still open?

scenes.speaker: emeka
scenes.text: The road is gone. But the old service path behind the workshop still reaches the clinic.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Emeka pulled an old map from a drawer and pointed toward the hills. The path was longer, but it avoided the flooded bridge.

scenes.speaker: sam
scenes.text: Thank you. I will make it before midnight.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The rain grew heavier as Sam followed the narrow road beyond the town. His phone battery dropped to its final bar.

scenes.speaker: sam
scenes.text: Come on. Just a little farther.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: At the end of the path, Sam found Daniel and Mama Ada waiting outside the clinic. The lights were still on.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Sam handed over the medicine. For the first time that night, Daniel smiled.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The storm finally began to weaken. Outside, the town was still dark, but a few windows started glowing one by one.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Sam looked back at the flooded road and smiled. The longest delivery of his life had finally reached its destination.
